description: This file defines a React component named ToolModal, which provides a modal dialog interface for adding or editing a tool configuration expressed in JSON format. It includes state management for the JSON data and validation for JSON syntax, and integrates with Ant Design UI components.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Validates the JSON input and triggers the onSave callback if valid; sets an error message otherwise.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Clears any errors and triggers the onClose callback.
